title: {{NAME}} and the Dimming Star Forest
moral: Even the smallest helper can make a big difference.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} flew into the Star Forest.
The trees were tall and full of tiny lights.
Fairies called to him from every branch.
A unicorn walked slowly through the shadows.
The stars in the trees were going out one by one.

"The stars need magic to shine," said Mira.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide.
"I want to help," he said.
Mira smiled and her wings glittered.
